name: pace
description: Rate-limit pacing in the terminal: 5-hour and weekly bars paced in dollars an hour across all parallel sessions (burst vs too fast), a per-prompt cost from the first prompt, the prompt-cache timer with the next prompt's cost in tokens and dollars and suggestions, a warm-cache mode, and /pace: burn-up charts in a terminal window of their own (two columns when wide; keys w, r, 1–9)

placement.title: Pace bar placement
placement.description: above: a band above the prompt. status: a row your status line prints from ~/.claude/pacebar-row.txt

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: 1 hour until a model switch reports otherwise. Set 5m if your account caches for 5 minutes

terminal.title: Terminal app for /pace
terminal.description: The macOS app /pace opens its window in (Terminal, iTerm, Ghostty…)
